Keep planche quality high and repeatable, and build the dip goal from both ends: one heavy reserve day and one specific +60 kg volume day. Lower body stays productive but low-cost for BJJ, and Zone 2 is kept easy enough to recover from.

Weeks 2-4: add a little hold time, a little density, or a small load bump only if positions stay clean. Week 4 consolidates with slightly harder top work, not a full deload.

Pain/substitutions: keep all planche work on parallettes. If wrists feel irritated, shorten the hold slightly before changing the shape, and use an extra warm-up set. If front squat feels unusually beat-up from BJJ, swap that day to Goblet Squat at similar effort. Avoid adding any extra hard conditioning.
